raw_requirement: Create an 18 kW motor drive panel using Schneider atv630u07m3

clarification_needed.question: Motor standard class: Please confirm if the motor is a standard 18.5 kW (25 HP) IEC/NEMA motor, or if the exact 18 kW rating is a specific requirement for a machine?
Supply voltage and frequency: Please confirm the exact supply voltage and frequency at the installation site.

options: Confirm 18.5 kW motor, size VFD accordingly
Please specify a different motor size or VFD model
clarification_needed.question: VFD Model Discrepancy: You mentioned 'Schneider atv630u07m3'. Please note that 'ATV630U07M3' is a model for a 0.75kW motor. For an 18.5 kW motor, a different Schneider ATV630 model (e.g., ATV630D18N4 for 18.5 kW, 400V) would be required. Do you confirm the 18 kW motor size, and we will select the appropriate ATV630 drive?

extracted_params.motor_kw_note: User specified 18 kW; standard IEC/NEMA motor manufacturing typically offers 18.5 kW (approx 25 HP). The panel will be designed for this standard rating (38A FLA at 415V).
provisional_assumptions: Assumed 415V AC, 3-Phase, 50Hz standard Indian/European industrial supply voltage and frequency.
Assumed standard 18.5 kW (approx 25 HP) normal duty motor classification, resulting in a Full Load Current (FLA) of approximately 38A at 415V.
Assumed standard industrial indoor panel design with IP54 ingress protection, suitable for a wall-mount or floor-standing configuration.
Assumed bottom cable entry for both mains power and motor power cables, which is common for industrial panels.
Assumed basic control requirements including local pushbuttons (Start/Stop), a selector switch for Auto/Manual or Local/Remote operation, and a dedicated Emergency Stop pushbutton.
